description: This file defines a React functional component for a Sign In pane in a web application's purchase flow. It manages user input for email and password, handles sign-in logic including validation and API interaction, and renders the sign-in UI with styling and icons.

classes.name: SignIn
classes.description: A React functional component that provides a user interface for signing into the application, including input fields, validation, and interaction with the application's sign-in API.

methods.name: handleSignIn
methods.description: Handles the sign-in process, including validation, API call, and error handling.

methods.name: handleCreateAccountInstead
methods.description: Transitions the UI to the account creation pane.

methods.name: handleEmailChange
methods.description: Updates email state and resets validation on change.

methods.name: handlePasswordChange
methods.description: Updates password state and resets validation on change.
